content: If a DcmDspDid is used in service 0x2F and is con- figured to have an atomic S/R interface, the DcmDspDidControlMask shall be set to DCM_CONTROLMASK_EXTERNAL and the parameter DcmDspDidControlMaskSize shall be present with a value greater than zero.
